newsitem.title: FRANCE: AGF share up, Morgan Stanley upgrades view.
newsitem.headline: AGF share up, Morgan Stanley upgrades view.

text.p: U.S. investment bank Morgan Stanley said on Friday it had changed stance on the recently privatised French insurer AGF to outperform from neutral.
AGF shares were up 1.6 francs, or 1.14 percent, at 141.4 francs at 1125 GMT with nearly 226,000 shares traded, while the CAC 40 leading share index was up 0.91 percent.
Morgan Stanley said that restructuring was starting to bear fruit, in particular in property, and the brokerage also said it was positive on the results outlook for this year and next.

AGF said on September 20 it expected a 1996 net profit of around double the 723 million francs for the first half and that it was heading the right way to achieve its aim of doubling a 1994 net profit of 880 million francs in 1997.
